scope: Public official HTML/CDN GETs plus read-only current repository comparison. No account credentials, authenticated request, business POST, WebSocket connection, player execution, Flutter execution, or production edit.
source_chain: 81004 HTML -> current app/bilibili bundles; fanspanel HTML -> index -> FansHome -> reqfansGroup/index-D1DYlSRj. Source hashes are current retrievals, not guessed old resource URLs.

observations.finding: Player playing event calls app module 7798 uS; pause calls TA; live status change starts or stops the same tracker.

U/Oo checks actual room live state, WASM support, login, and duplicate-start state; updates room_id, area_id, parent_area_id, ruid, trackid and calls module 46653 C.start. No message WebSocket state or roomEntryAction response is checked in this function.

Module 87654 exports gF/G: POST roomEntryAction with body room_id and platform pc. The two imports of this module located in the current main app bundle call lk (statistics initialization), not gF; no caller of gF was located in the searched main bundles. Dynamic chunks and server dependencies remain unproven.

Watcher init/checkAndFixRoomInfo use getRoomBaseInfo with req_biz web_heartbeat only when room metadata is invalid. reportEnter establishes server interval/rules/key/timestamp; reportHeartBeat uses interval and checks response code==0 before reporting success. No response s field comparison was found.

E fields: id [parent_id,area_id,page-global seq,room_id], device [LIVE_BUVID string,page-global UUID string], ruid, ts milliseconds, is_patch, heart_beat serialized patch data, ua. First seq is zero. No ws token, live_key, up_session or media play URL is present.

X adds ets, benchmark, time, ts milliseconds, ua, trackid default -999998, and spyder signature s. body is signed from the current server secret_rule/key; server timestamp/rules/key/interval can rotate after X.

up_session appears in a separate periodic statistics record logId 000916 along with live_key/sub_session_key and media play URL. Its appearance in telemetry does not establish that it is required for E/X intimacy settlement.

FansGroup reads GetActivatedMedalInfo with target_id, platform, scene club. reqfansGroup wrapper adds env.origin_room_id as room_id, and adds a native build only when getSystemInfo returns a positive build; browser fallback can omit build. Current repo loadFanTasks uses target_id, room_id, platform pc, scene club.

task_info is copied directly to task list and rendered title/add_text/sub_title/is_done/jump_type. No 5-minute/15-minute, 2-round/10-round client branch or locally synthesized task period was found in this component or its request wrapper.
The watchLive task button invokes ue(), the environment-specific panel-close helper. It does not invoke a new watch-activation/claim endpoint in this task mapping.

Getter reads is_lighted, free_intimacy, light_source and reach_free_intimacy_limit; it does not wear or activate a medal. The UI gates the completed label and rights on is_lighted and displays savings-to-claim text when unlit. Task list is still supplied by server while unlit. This is not proof that watch counter requires wearing or lighting.
FansHome component selection uses existing fan-club level; this is not a viewer watch heartbeat protocol-version switch.
reqfansGroup imports N as ue; index exports WB as N. WB emits parent close when PC, otherwise calls native closeView. This resolves watchLive callback to panel closing only.

repo_comparison.e_and_x_first_continuous_session: Parameter names, identity arrays, millisecond ts, server interval/time, challenge and native WASM signature match current public construction; existing offline vectors establish signature parity only.
lifecycle_differences: Web page UUID and seq survive same-page pause/room updates; repo uses fresh UUID and seq0 for new E session.
Web stop uses a random 10-60 second delay and submits a partial tail; repo stops immediately and discards interrupted tail.
Web can retry failures and synthesize ets when server timestamp is lost; repo does neither and fails closed.
repo_comparison.insufficient_to_explain_reported_cold_fa: These lifecycle differences do not by themselves explain a continuous accepted 960 seconds with a 900-second task round. No unverified workaround was implemented.
repo_comparison.signature_confirmation: Public WASM was re-fetched this run with unchanged SHA256 22d5483eb75e46725342e5e61ef1384678962cb7de5fdcc61b79017fa9524717. Current repo canonical platform/identity/time fields remain as its 16 existing official-WASM offline vectors; no authenticated signing experiment was run here.

parent_report_context_not_independently_.cold_task: 15 minutes per round, daily 10 rounds; native audio playback 1006 valid seconds, E/X accepted seconds 960, watch remained 0/10; first fan emote task reached 10/10.
parent_report_context_not_independently_.hot_task: 81004 uses 5-minute rounds, daily two rounds; same implementation previously observed 0/2 -> 1/2.
parent_report_context_not_independently_.boundary: Different room/task definitions are not a controlled paired protocol comparison; accepted E/X response does not certify task settlement.

unknowns: Backend joining of E/X, regular room entry, message presence and separate telemetry is not visible in these public modules.
Dynamic chunk callers of the exported roomEntryAction helper were not exhaustively enumerated.
Current-account is_lighted/medal-wearing/free-intimacy-cap/task-period state was not read by this research.
Server rollout, anti-abuse filtering, credit batching/delay and task-period semantics cannot be derived from presentation code.
next_minimal_readonly_comparison: Record safe boolean/state fields from already authorized task snapshots: is_lighted, free_intimacy, reach_free_intimacy_limit, level, jump_type, raw goal/progress/period fields; do not expose cookies/keys.
Keep room, actual room id, anchor id, task definition, source mode (audio vs video), accepted E/X seconds and refresh delay explicit; compare same account/room with ordinary client playback.

A single normal roomEntryAction experiment may test an association, but one outcome must not turn a static export into a proven universal prerequisite. No automatic medal wearing or paid lighting is justified.
